actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the quiet residential street at a moderate speed, approaching the prone person in the lane.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop well before the person and remains fully stationary for the remaining duration; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.
